newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to concentrate on documents this week.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to concentrate on documents this week.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin will concentrate on preparing his annual report to parliament at a residence outside Moscow this week and meetings will be limited, Interfax news agency said on Monday.

"All the head of state's aides will take an active part in the work on the document in the Gorky-9 residence. In connection with this the number of president's meetings will be limited," it said, quoting Kremlin spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky.
A Kremlin press spokesman told Reuters that Yeltsin's traditional Tuesday meeting with Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin might nevertheless go ahead.
Yeltsin held talks with visiting French President Jacques Chirac on Sunday, his first meeting with a Western leader since he went down with pneumonia on January 8.
Chirac told reporters he had held more than three hours of talks with the Kremlin leader, and was "very impressed" with the speed of Yeltsin's recovery.
Yeltsin underwent multiple bypass surgery on November 5 and has appeared rarely in the Kremlin since he was re-elected in July.
